prompt:
Build a closed-loop autonomous surface-vessel system in Simulink. The physical plant must model six-degree-of-freedom vessel motion with inertia, hydrostatic restoring effects, hydrodynamic and current-dependent forces, and two independently driven propellers. The controller must use measured vessel motion to track the requested forward speed and waypoint route through bounded propeller actuation.

The model must also evaluate the supplied traffic-vessel motion, identify potential close encounters, and perform rule-consistent collision-avoidance manoeuvres before returning to useful waypoint progress. Traffic motion is provided as ground truth; raw radar, lidar, camera processing, SLAM, wind and wave modelling are not required.

Read Waypoints_m, TrafficMotion, DesiredSpeed_mps, CurrentSpeed_mps, and CurrentDirection_deg from the MATLAB base workspace and support the ranges and formats stated in public_inputs. TrafficMotion may contain one, two, or three active traffic vessels.

Waypoints_m is an N-by-2 real matrix in m with columns [x_m, y_m]. TrafficMotion is a complete-run Timeseries with 18 channels in this exact order: [vessel1_x_m, vessel1_y_m, vessel1_vx_mps, vessel1_vy_mps, vessel1_yaw_rad, vessel1_active_flag, vessel2_x_m, vessel2_y_m, vessel2_vx_mps, vessel2_vy_mps, vessel2_yaw_rad, vessel2_active_flag, vessel3_x_m, vessel3_y_m, vessel3_vx_mps, vessel3_vy_mps, vessel3_yaw_rad, vessel3_active_flag]; inactive rows use active_flag=0. DesiredSpeed_mps is a real scalar in [1.2, 1.8] m/s; CurrentSpeed_mps is a real scalar in [0, 0.35] m/s; and CurrentDirection_deg is a real scalar in [-180, 180] deg.

Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named VesselState, GuidanceState, PropulsionState, TrafficState, and OperatingState. VesselState has 14 channels in this order: x,y,z (m); surge,sway,heave velocity (m/s); roll,pitch,yaw (rad); roll,pitch,yaw rate (rad/s); signed speed (m/s); and course (rad). GuidanceState has 7 channels [desired speed (m/s), desired yaw (rad), reference x,y (m), next-reference x,y (m), operating mode]. PropulsionState has 6 channels [desired surge thrust (N), desired yaw moment (N*m), left and right propeller command (rad/s), delivered surge force (N), delivered yaw moment (N*m)]. TrafficState contains three consecutive 10-channel vessel groups, each ordered [x_m,y_m,vx_mps,vy_mps,yaw_rad,closest-approach time_s,closest-approach distance_m,potential-collision flag,relative bearing_deg,encounter sector]. OperatingState has 4 channels [current speed (m/s), current direction (rad), autonomous-run flag, collision-avoidance-enabled flag]. Every recorded value must come from the connected physical, control, traffic-assessment, or planning path.

Save the completed model as cand_XROBO09.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
